art_note: High-end luxury lifestyle imagery with sophisticated lighting and upscale architectural settings.
desc_en: A bold and vibrant statement piece designed to stand out. These fitted shorts feature a striking neon electric lime hue that radiates dynamism. Crafted with a brushed faux suede finish offering an ultra-soft touch, they balance high fashion sportswear with a precise anatomical fit. The signature monogram adorns the side, completing a piece designed for exclusivity.
desc_es: Una declaración de estilo audaz y vibrante diseñada para destacar. Estos shorts ceñidos se presentan en un tono verde lima neón que irradia dinamismo. Confeccionados con un acabado de ante sintético cepillado de textura ultrasuave al tacto, equilibran la alta moda deportiva con un ajuste anatómico preciso. El monograma distintivo adorna el lateral, completando una pieza concebida para la exclusividad.
